The Secretaría de Salud de Cali stated it verified habilitación conditions within 24 hours of the October 2025 death and found a shortfall in the talento humano criterion (plastikos-press-elespectador). clinics.cautions: Death and closure: Alicia Stone, a 40-year-old NYPD detective, had liposuction and a gluteal lift (BBL) at Plastikos Cirujanos on about October 16, 2025, was found unresponsive in her hotel about a week later and died at Fundación Valle del Lili; the preliminary cause was recorded as unspecified cardiac arrest and the Fiscalía and Medicina Legal opened investigations (plastikos-press-elcolombiano, plastikos-press-elpais-oct). The Secretaría de Salud Municipal de Cali ordered a temporary closure after finding non-compliance in the talento humano component of habilitación; El Espectador and TuBarco describe the measure as covering the cosmetic surgery service, while El País describes a total temporary closure of the establishment (plastikos-press-elespectador, plastikos-press-tubarco, plastikos-press-elpais). TuBarco reported the clinic filed a requerimiento de subsanación for the Secretaría to evaluate (plastikos-press-tubarco). As of November 2, 2026 no report of the measure being lifted or of the investigation's outcome was found; current operating status is unknown.
